question: Which reusable proof APIs establish package, browser and raw-device behavior without duplicate inventories?
trigger: The owner asked for a best-api-review audit of every open ledger unit, frozen from status at fe0e9599a6 on 2026-10-04 (39 units), and judged afresh because earlier verdicts came from a weaker model. It asked for verdicts only, so no plan, build or panel follows in this run. This scope was open as deferred at queue position 41. It is not the unit next returned, which was reads.
requirements: A raw mobile or device claim needs evidence that real input reached the named build on a named device; viewport or proxy evidence never counts (docs/vision/common.md claim width).
Public proof APIs validate untrusted lane evidence and exact source identity; caller-provided success flags and transport names are claims, not proof (docs/vision/plite.md).
Device runs are local and add no GitHub Actions minutes (owner direction in docs/plans/2026-10-02-proof-device-lane.md Defaults).
One inventory per proof claim; the scope question excludes duplicate inventories.
No fake compatibility, so public names, exports and docs teach only capabilities that exist (VISION.md Common Essentials).
A release-ready claim fails closed on missing or untrusted producer evidence (.agents/rules/release-lanes.mdc).
evidenceReuse: Reused the release-trust and agentic-e2e records, the device-lane plan, its decision log and the 2026-10-03 execution record. Rechecked on the live tree the raw-mobile-proof.ts flag checks, the proof/index.ts exports, the package.json scripts and every caller (none outside its own tests, the package import smoke test and the README), the release-lanes.mdc producer status, the check-plite-release-proof.mjs lane list, the verify commands.md and editor-proof.md routing, common.md and plite.md doctrine, the iOS probe result JSON, and commits after the execution record (209bbb7ff3 changed witness.ts pairing after the five-run proof). No newer plan or record touches the scope.
summary: The job is to establish raw-device behavior through proof APIs that validate evidence, with one inventory per claim. The Defer waited for a release that needs raw Android proof or for the iOS probe. The release-ready profile that holds the raw-mobile lane cannot run at all, because Plite CI emits no plite-release-proof, and the iOS probe is still quarantined on the iOS 26.5 platform per the 2026-10-03 execution limits. Meanwhile the live raw gate (validateRawMobileProof plus tooling/plite/donor/proof/mobile-device-proof.mjs) accepts a receipt only when it declares directAppium, an appium transport and device.realDevice: true, so its real-device property rests on self-declared flags. No tool writes its input file, no CI, release or check script calls it, and the public README teaches a direct-Appium lane the repo does not have. The only real Android producer is the private device lane (adb, guarded DevTools, judgeDeviceWitness), which this gate never reads, and common.md's claim width already routes Android soft-keyboard claims to it. The strongest alternative, building the re-derived lane receipt now, adds gate machinery no authorized release would run, and keeping schema 1 keeps a fake-authority public API and a second scenario inventory. Cut schema 1 and its runner now, and design the re-derived receipt only when a release claim is authorized.

callSites.current: bun test:mobile-device-proof:raw reads test-results/release-proof/mobile-device-proof.json and passes only receipts that declare directAppium: true, transport appium-android or appium-ios and device.realDevice: true for all 16 RAW_MOBILE_SCENARIOS on both platforms, via validateRawMobileProof from @platejs/test/proof; nothing writes that file. Android soft-keyboard evidence comes from PLATE_DEVICE_WWW_PORT=3000 pnpm --filter plite exec playwright test --config playwright.device.config.ts after node tooling/device/android.mjs doctor, which the gate never reads.
callSites.proposed: Proposed: @platejs/test/proof no longer exports RAW_MOBILE_SCENARIOS, validateRawMobileProof, assertRawMobileProof, the RawMobile* types or classifyBrowserMobileTransportProof; package.json drops test:mobile-device-proof and test:mobile-device-proof:raw and tooling/plite/donor/proof/mobile-device-proof.mjs is deleted. A raw Android claim runs only through the device lane (node tooling/device/android.mjs doctor, then pnpm --filter plite exec playwright test --config playwright.device.config.ts) within common.md's emulator claim width; the release-ready raw-mobile lane stays fail-closed until an authorized release claim builds the re-derived lane receipt from 2026-10-02-proof-release-trust.

reconciliation.reason: Its Stop on adopting e2e and Pursue of the local lane stand; its finding that the raw-mobile validator never received a receipt and that lane receipts should replace the directAppium requirement is what this verdict lands as a cut.

alternatives: Keeping it and staying Defer loses. Both named triggers are absent, but they decide only the future re-derived receipt, not whether a producerless public receipt that trusts self-declared flags should exist.

Building the re-derived lane receipt now (the deferred target) loses for now. The release-ready profile cannot run because no plite-release-proof producer exists and the iOS half is quarantined, so new gate code would have no caller. It stays the target for an authorized release claim.

Hard-cutting schema 1 (RAW_MOBILE_SCENARIOS, validateRawMobileProof, assertRawMobileProof, the RawMobile* types, the Appium and agent-browser transport classifier), its runner scripts and docs, and routing raw Android claims to the device lane wins. It deletes a fake-authority public API, a dead runner and a second Android scenario inventory, and the release-ready raw-mobile lane in check-plite-release-proof.mjs still fails closed independently.
Keeping schema 1 for a future iOS Appium lane loses as hypothetical reuse. An iOS lane would need its own witness and guard, not self-declared flags.
Moving the 16-row scenario list to docs/editor-behavior coverage instead of a public constant is optional. The plan decides whether the list still has coverage value.
proofLimits: Source and history review only; no gate, device lane or test ran. External consumers of @platejs/test/proof outside this repository are unknown. Whether the release-ready profile keeps a raw-mobile lane is a release-lanes decision the plan must settle. The device lane's five-run proof predates the 209bbb7ff3 witness change and covers one emulator and Gboard 17.0.14. Whether the iOS 26.5 platform is installed now was not checked; the repository holds no later probe run. docs/vision/plite.md and docs/research/features/proof.md carry other sessions' uncommitted edits, but the cited law is committed.
